scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的类型形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this world's type appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对那个物种的侮辱性称呼。
note.en: In the game, an insulting name for that species appears here.
